blurb: Guests can experience tandem skydiving from 14,000 feet with a certified instructor, including about 60 seconds of freefall and approximately five minutes of canopy flight. The dropzone also offers the Accelerated Freefall (AFF) program, a seven-level course to become a licensed solo skydiver. Experienced skydivers can use the facilities and aircraft for sport jumps.
